title: Debate: should governments invest more in fusion?
description: A structured English debate on public money for fusion research: dated evidence cards for both sides, roles, timing, debate language and transparent assessment criteria.

sources.title: EUROfusion: JET's final tritium experiments yield new fusion energy record (8 February 2024)
sources.note: 69.26 MJ in a pulse of about six seconds, 0.21 mg of fuel; campaign from September 2023.

sources.title: National Ignition Facility (Wikipedia)
sources.note: 5 December 2022: 3.15 MJ from 2.05 MJ of laser light; the laser pulse took about 300 MJ of electricity; 8.6 MJ in 2025.

sources.title: Deuterium (Wikipedia): 155.76 deuterium atoms per million hydrogen atoms in ocean water
sources.note: About 0.035 g of deuterium in a litre of water (computed from this abundance).

sources.title: ITER Organization: Advantages of fusion
sources.note: Lithium reserves on land for more than 1000 years; no high-activity, long-lived waste; recycling within 100 years; the plasma cools within seconds after a disturbance.

sources.title: ITER Organization: Safety and environment
sources.note: A few grams of tritium in the plasma at any time.

sources.title: Ember: Global Electricity Review 2026, 2025 in review
sources.note: Renewables 33.8 %, coal 33.0 %, wind and solar 17.3 % of world electricity in 2025.

sources.title: World Nuclear News: Fusion industry raised USD 4.5 billion in past year, report says (14 July 2026)
sources.note: Fusion Industry Association survey of 56 companies: USD 4.48 billion in the year to July 2026, USD 14.24 billion in total; companies still need government support.

sources.title: SolarQuarter: Private fusion industry reaches USD 14.24 billion (15 July 2026), report on the same FIA survey
sources.note: Of the total, USD 13.26 billion from private investors and USD 980.7 million from public sources.

sources.title: ITER (Wikipedia): 2006 cost estimate, later estimates, 2024 baseline
sources.note: EUR 5.9 billion over ten years (2006); EUR 18–22 billion projected; July 2024 baseline: research operation 2034, D–D 2035, D–T 2039, about EUR 5 billion for repairs; over 300 MW of electricity, no electricity produced.

sources.title: Commonwealth Fusion Systems (Wikipedia)
sources.note: Founded 2018 as a spin-off from the MIT Plasma Science and Fusion Center; US Department of Energy milestone-based funding in May 2023, with seven other companies.

sources.title: Alcator C-Mod (Wikipedia)
sources.note: Proposed to the US Department of Energy in 1985, operated 1991–2016, record plasma pressure of 2.05 atmospheres in 2016.
